fragments.title: Keep Foundry calibration readback in the admitted Foundry facade
fragments.summary: The legacy uncertainty Node consumes the strict reader directly from the admitted Foundry uncertainty facade. The unreleased Calibration alias is removed to preserve the Calibration import boundary.

Foundry and Funnel report contracts remain distinct.

fragments.title: Route Welfare covariance through the admitted Foundry uncertainty facade
fragments.summary: Welfare consumes five canonical covariance functions and tolerance constants through the existing admitted uncertainty root. Lazy resolution preserves object identity and optional numeric import behavior.
fragments.compatibility: Five additive canonical exports; covariance math, calibrated projection, persisted artifacts and IR wire semantics remain unchanged. Existing facade import remains available when the optional JAX stack is absent; requesting the numeric exports preserves the real dependency error.
fragments.migration: Use polisyos.foundry.uncertainty for the existing covariance functions and v1 reconciliation tolerances.
fragments.limitations: These exports do not establish a production source law, calibrated evaluator authority, Core/IR entrypoint admission or finding closure.
